brief: Kosovo's supply-side announcement landscape is real but thin and highly asymmetric: the vendors that serve Kosovo banks are almost entirely regional or global (Asseco SEE/Payten, Printec, Quipu, NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf, Temenos) plus a small set of local integrators (Cacttus, InfoSoft Systems Kosovo, LinkPlus IT, Horizon Plus), and their corporate newsrooms — not Kosovo procurement portals — are where a named contract is most likely to appear first. Two confirmed instances validate the cell's premise: Quipu publicly documenting ProCredit Bank Kosovo's mobile-banking and core-integration rebuild, and Horizon Plus publishing a Central Bank of Kosovo digital-platform case study. However, repeated searching in sq, sr and en found no Kosovo-specific press release on the big regional vendors' own newsrooms, which strongly suggests Kosovo wins are communicated through LinkedIn, local events and association sponsorships rather than formal releases. The highest-return next moves are LinkedIn/company-page monitoring for the vendor entities registered in Kosovo, mapping the currently unknown core-banking and card-switch layer, and using app-store developer metadata as a cheap, reliable reveals-indirectly signal.
